results.title: The story behind the first CIA officers in Afghanistan after 9/11 and the Russian chopper that flew them in
results.description: Twenty-five years ago, a Soviet-designed helicopter crossed the mountains of Afghanistan with the first CIA officers sent into the country after 9/11, the opening move in what would later become America's longest war.

results.title: Palace to Philippines VP Sara Duterte: Respond with evidence, stop using fallacies
results.description: MANILA: Malacañang on Saturday (Sept 26) called on Vice President Sara Duterte to learn how to respond to accusations using evidence, instead of relying on 'red herring' and 'ad hominem' fallacies.
